how_to_apply: Check eligibility criteria for the Project Associate I position from the official notification.
Visit the official CSIR-NEERI website at www.neeri.res.in.
Submit the online application form before the last date of 14-10-2026.
Ensure you hold the required provisional certificate and declared result before applying, as result-awaited candidates are not eligible.
important_instructions: The positions are purely temporary and co-terminus with the aforementioned projects. Engagement will not confer any right implicit or explicit on the candidate for considering regularization against any CSIR/CSIR-NEERI post(s). Tenure of project staff who have served CSIR-NEERI or any other laboratories/Institutes of CSIR under contract R&D projects shall not exceed six or seven years as per clause no. 1.6/1.7 of CSIR OM No. 5-1(342)/2017-PD Dated 02.09.2024. Only candidates who have acquired the essential qualification and whose result has been declared with at least provisional certificate are eligible to apply. Result awaited, final semester appeared, or Ph.D. submitted candidates are not eligible to apply. Selected candidates are expected to join within the time frame mentioned in the offer letter after pre-appointment formalities like medical examination and character verification. Selected candidates shall sign an undertaking for maintaining confidentiality of project findings and/or associated intellectual property information. Project staff shall make their own arrangement for accommodation; HRA is admissible as per applicable rules. No TA will be paid for appearing in interviews in case of offline interviews.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment organisation for this advertisement?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by CSIR-National Environmental Engineering Research Institute (CSIR-NEERI), Nagpur.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Project Associate-I (PAT-I) post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the online application form?
faq.answer: The last date of submission of online application form is 14-10-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential qualification required for Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. in Environmental Science / Geoinformatics / Remote Sensing & GIS from a recognized University.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for the Project Associate-I position?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years as on the last date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for CSIR NEERI recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates are not required to pay any application fees.

faq.question: Q7. What is the monthly salary for Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: Monthly emoluments are Rs. 31,000/- + HRA for NET/GATE or national level exam qualified candidates, and Rs. 25,000/- + HRA for others.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Selection will be done on the basis of an online interview conducted through MS Team, Skype, or similar platforms.

faq.question: Q9. Are result-awaited candidates eligible to apply?
faq.answer: No, only candidates who have acquired the essential qualification and whose results have been declared (possessing at least a provisional certificate) are eligible.
